consistency.notes: All three photos show the same white, sheer, fine-rib jersey sleeveless top. It has a high crew neck at the front, cut-in armholes, two wide straps that cross on the upper back, and an open back down to about mid-back. Photo 1 shows a V-shaped inner layer as a shadow through the front. Photo 3 shows the right side seam and the hem.

layers.name: outer body (front + lower back + straps)
layers.note: Sheer white rib jersey. Skin and the inner V layer show through it.

layers.name: inner front V-panel / modesty lining
layers.note: A second layer behind the front, covering the upper chest. It is caught into the neckband and the armhole bindings at the top. Its lower edge is a free V with the point at about BUST_C. It shows only as a soft shadow line.

layers.name: back panel
layers.note: Single layer from about mid-back down to the hem. It is the same cloth as the outer front and is joined to it at the side seams.

items.note: High crew neck finished at the front only. It runs into the crossed straps at the neck points.

Starts as the whole left shoulder (NP_L to SP_L width). It goes over the back, crosses the right strap at UB_C and ends at the right side, mid-back height, where it meets the back panel. Its edges are folded or bound.
Mirror of strap_L. Which strap lies on top at the cross is uncertain.
Cut-in front armhole, bound or turned. Its upper end continues into the strap's outer edge.
Short back armhole edge below the underarm. It is formed by the outer edge of the lower end of strap_R.
Shallow U-shaped top edge of the back panel, dipping slightly at MB_C. A small vertical tack or seam mark sits at MB_C.
Large open back, from below the strap cross at UB_C down to MB_C.
Side seam, set slightly forward of the true side.
Straight hem just below the waist. It is a narrow, slightly curling, raw-looking finish.
Same finish as the front hem.
Lower edge of the inner V-panel, seen as a shadow through the outer front. The point of the V is at the under-bust centre.
The top of the inner panel is caught into the neckband and the upper armhole/strap finish.
